definition: things leaving my life outright when there is no room for them in what surrounds me

settled:
There is no middle state. I either build a thing into what surrounds me or it disappears.

Not deferred, and not held in reserve somewhere. Gone.

A lot has gone that way, most of it through the years when I could not afford it. Scarcity narrowed what I had room to build in, and whatever did not fit did not wait.

How much company I kept ran the same shape. Surroundings too narrow to carry a thing push the thing out, and coming back is a slow widening as capacity returns.

As I recover I am starting to widen again, after contracting that far.

title: What Disappears If I Do Not Build It In
